products.name: Cisco ISE 802.1X Certificate Authentication for Wi-Fi & Wired via Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Issue certificates from Intune and deploy Wi-Fi and wired 802.1X profiles that authenticate to Cisco ISE over EAP-TLS — on-prem NAC for every device, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Certificate-authenticate every device onto Wi-Fi and wired with Cisco ISE

Pre-shared Wi-Fi keys and open switch ports are an open door. 802.1X with certificates makes every device prove identity before it touches the network — but delivering the certs and Wi-Fi/wired profiles to a fleet is the hard part. This solution issues certificates from Intune and deploys the Wi-Fi and wired 802.1X profiles that authenticate to Cisco ISE over EAP-TLS — the on-prem NAC counterpart to certificate VPN, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how 802.1X / EAP-TLS works for Wi-Fi and wired with ISE as the RADIUS authority, the certificate + network-profile model, and where Intune delivery meets the Cisco switching/wireless infrastructure.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a CA / Cloud PKI, Intune SCEP/PKCS + trusted-root profiles, Wi-Fi/wired 802.1X profile settings, ISE policy for EAP-TLS, Entra groups, a pilot group) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to deploy the certificate and trusted-root profiles, build the Wi-Fi and wired 802.1X device profiles in Intune, assign to a named pilot group, validate ISE authenticates the device, then expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — 802.1X readiness discovery, per-device certificate + network-profile validation, a Wi-Fi/wired profile coverage report, safe remediation of missing profiles/certs, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates (cert present, profile applied, ISE 802.1X auth success), plus Best Practices for supplicant and renewal.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Every device certificate-authenticated onto Wi-Fi and wired by Cisco ISE — profiles and certs delivered from Intune, and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ISE8021X-Discovery.ps1 — Tenant-wide readiness check for 802.1X EAP-TLS (cert connectors + trusted-root/SCEP/PKCS/Wi-Fi/wired profiles) via Microsoft Graph
    • ISE8021X-Remediation.ps1 — Safely fix missing 802.1X profile/cert assignments by adding the target group to the relevant Intune profiles (default -WhatIf)
    • ISE8021X-Report.ps1 — Fleet coverage report for the 802.1X EAP-TLS Wi-Fi/wired profiles and the device certificate via Microsoft Graph
    • ISE8021X-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — Create and populate the pilot Entra security group(s) used as 802.1X profile assignment targets (default -WhatIf)
    • ISE8021X-Validation.ps1 — Confirm the 802.1X EAP-TLS client certificate and the Wi-Fi + wired profiles are applied on THIS device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
